beats.text: Quick guess: how many hours does it take to make a close friend?
It's more than you think. Here's the math!
A researcher surveyed hundreds of adults who had just moved. And followed new college students for weeks.
From stranger to casual friend: about fifty hours.
To real friend: about ninety. And a close friend?
So if it's not clicking yet: keep showing up!

sources: Hall (2019), How many hours does it take to make a friend?, Journal of Social and Personal Relationships 36(4) – 355 adults who had recently moved + 112 first-year students: ~50 h to casual friend, ~90 h to friend, 200+ h to close friend.
